user.title: Bright Rooms
user.description: Bright Rooms switches the lights of each light zone with its presence sensors and the daylight. After this step, add the light zones from the integration page or from the Bright Rooms panel.

init.title: Settings
init.description: How the ambient light is computed and how each light's contribution is learned.

data.settle_seconds: Settling time after a light changes
data.learn_ambient_max: Learn only with ambient light up to
data.learn_min_previous: Learn only if the light was unchanged for

data_description.settle_seconds: The ambient light is held for this long after a light of a zone changes: illuminance sensors report late and some lamps ramp up. It is also the time between the two readings of a measurement.
data_description.learn_ambient_max: Contributions are measured only with little daylight, when the jump of the sensor is clear.
data_description.learn_weight: A new measurement moves the learned value by this share (0.2 = 20 %).

error.no_presence: Choose at least one presence sensor.
error.bright_not_above_dark: Must be higher than the dark threshold.
error.brightness_lux_order: Must be higher than the lowest brightness value.
error.light_in_other_room: One of these lights already belongs to another light zone.
error.schedule_invalid: A band is not valid: check its time window or light condition, its days and its overrides (at least one).
error.neighbor_invalid: Choose zones that exist, other than this one.

data_description.name: Shown in the panel and on the zone's device, for example "Cooktop" or "Table".
data_description.area: The room the zone belongs to: its zones share the room's Automatic switch and, by default, count as each other's nearby presence.
data_description.presence_sensors: The zone is occupied while at least one of them is on.
data_description.zone_sensors: Other presence sensors that count as nearby presence. While one of them is on, turning off waits longer: people often move nearby and come back.
data_description.lights: The lights Bright Rooms switches. A light can belong to one zone only.
data_description.illuminance_sensor: Optional. Without it the zone always counts as dark and dimmable lights turn on at full brightness.
data_description.other_lights: Lights of other rooms, or not managed by Bright Rooms, that the illuminance sensor sees: if one changes during a measurement, the measurement is discarded.
data_description.on_delay: Continuous presence needed before the lights turn on.
data_description.only_when_dark: Ambient light is measured without the zone's own lights.
data_description.bright_above: Must be higher than the dark threshold: in between, the zone keeps its previous state.
data_description.off_when_bright: Also with people in the zone, but only when it goes from dark to bright: a light turned on by hand when it is already bright stays on.
data_description.on_when_dark: When it goes from bright to dark with someone in the zone and every light off, the lights turn on as if they had just come in. Only on that change: lights turned off by hand once it is dark stay off. Used only with "Turn on only when dark".
data_description.min_off_seconds: For lamps that change tint when switched off and on quickly.
data_description.brightness_min: Dimmable lights: brightness when the ambient light is at or below the next value; 100 % at the full brightness value, linear in between.
data_description.empty_wait: With the zone and its nearby presence empty, before dimming or turning off.
data_description.dim_percent: Dimmable lights are dimmed to this share of their brightness as a warning before turning off (100 % = no warning). If someone comes back, they return to their brightness.
data_description.auto_neighbors: Their presence sensors make turning off wait longer, as nearby presence.
data_description.neighbor_zones: Zones of any room whose presence sensors also count as nearby presence (an open kitchen next to the living room).
data_description.auto_other_lights: Only for measuring the lamps' contribution: a change of one of them during a measurement discards it.

user.description: A light zone is a group of lights switched by its own presence sensors. Zones are grouped into rooms by their area: the zones of the same area count as each other's nearby presence. The contribution of each light is learned by itself, or can be set in the Bright Rooms panel.
